description: This file defines the ReportService class which provides reporting functionalities such as totals by category and daily spend, utilizing the ReportRepository. It acts as a service layer in the backend for managing report-related data operations.

classes.name: ReportService
classes.description: Provides methods to generate reporting data such as totals by category and daily spending for users within a date range.

methods.name: None __init__(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the ReportService with a database session and sets up the report repository.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,object]] totals_by_category(self, user_id: int, start: date, end: date)
methods.description: Returns total expenses grouped by category for a specific user and date range.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,object]] daily_spend(self, user_id: int, start: date, end: date)
methods.description: Returns daily spending data for a user over a specified period.
